description: Disconnect a Lemon Squeezy or SparkLoop integration and stop live ingestion and sync. Deletes only the managed provider webhook; manual webhooks remain. Local disconnection succeeds even if provider cleanup fails: inspect cleanupWarning. Repeating the call retries Lemon Squeezy cleanup; for SparkLoop, delete the leftover webhook in SparkLoop. Other providers require the dashboard. Requires integrations:manage and owner/admin access.

companyId.description: Company ID; defaults to the selected company.

integrationId.description: Lemon Squeezy or SparkLoop integration ID.

name: disconnect_integration

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `disconnect_integration` MCP tool.

cleanupWarning.description: Null after successful cleanup. A warning means locally disconnected; repeat disconnect to retry managed webhook removal.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
